gheid: HELENA—Good-bye, Gheid Storm, and as you go down the hill, will you lock the gate, a dog thief passed in the night, taking my terrier with him.
GHEID— You’ve got funny dogs, they don’t even bark. [Pause.] I expected you’d set them on me; however, perhaps that will come later——
At about the same moment as the curtain’s rising, GHEID STORM vaults the window-sill.
HELENA—I am a woman, Gheid Storm, who is not in need.
GHEID STORM—As you never let me in at the door, I thought of the window.
GHEID is tall, but much too honourable to be jaunty, he is decidedly masculine.
